description: Owner opt-outs for automatically imported app-ad rules. exclude_hosts: no imported block, rewrite or decryption on these hosts and their subdomains (use when an app breaks). exclude_patterns: exact imported rewrite patterns to drop. Own rules in data/apps.json are not affected. observe_hosts: decrypt only, never block or rewrite, so the device log shows full URLs while an ad endpoint is being located; each entry carries until (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 21 days ahead) and the build stops decrypting it after that day; remove the entry once the rule is written.
